Home Brick White White Outside Corner
The corner panels are easily installed from the box to the wall in minutes, using deck screws and common tools. A brick corner piece links 1 wall of a project to the next. This creates a seamless transition and allows you to expand your project as needed. Each corner panel is 22.5 in. tall and provides 1.91 sq. ft. of coverage.
